description: This file contains testing utilities for validation of Kubernetes runtime objects, including functions to run validation and update validation across different versions and schemes.

methods.name: RunValidationForEachVersion
methods.description: Runs a validation function as a subtest for each version of an unversioned runtime object, using a provided scheme and options.

methods.name: RunUpdateValidationForEachVersion
methods.description: Runs an update validation function as a subtest for each version of an unversioned runtime object, comparing with an old object.
